name: Permits & Licensing Committee Special Meeting
minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  MINUTES
  June 19, 2025

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900 -6833,
meeting ID: 880 1873 0595 and Password 51609 on June 19, 2025 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh- Administration
  Christine Rivera - Planning Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson - Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service Department

  Staff Present:  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the
item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits &
License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Otto Benedict on Behalf of Live Nation at SoFi Stadium to host The Weekend After
  Hours Til Dawn Event at 1001 Stadium Dr. – SoFi Stadium; Private Property; from
  Wednesday , June 25. 2025, Thursday, June 26, 2025, Saturday, June 28, 2025,
  and Sunday, June 29, 2025, from 7:30 p.m. – 11:59 p.m. Approval for 4 day event
  within SoFi stadium; Approved, Applicant shall provide sufficient SoFi Stadium
  Security and Inglewood Police Department (IPD) staffing to ensure the safety of all
  attendees and event personnel; All employees must possess valid identification,
  which shall be made available upon request to IPD officers;California Department of
  Alcoholic Beverage Control Agents and City of Inglewood Code Enforcement
  personnel.The applicant shall ensure complete and unrestricted access to the venue
  for all on duty first responder personnel (law enforcement, fire and code enforcement
  staff). Any drone usage must receive prior written approval from both SoFi Stadium
  management and the LAX Control Tower; All drone operators must submit valid
  identification and any required state or federal licensing with the event application;
  The City of Inglewood must be notified in advance of any drone deployment;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of
  the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set
  forth by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere
  to all State, Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and
  Approval for 4 day event within SoFi stadium, No exterior amplified music.
   Applicant is responsible for crowd control, event clean up, and all applicable
  mitigation measures. Applicant shall provide sufficient Code Enforcement Officers
  for any unpermitted vending.regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried
  unanimously (Activity No. 00405946)

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Permits & License Committee on any matter with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time. Adjournment
